changes_made.explanation: Normalized dataset names to consistent capitalization, removed redundant/duplicate entries, and added more specific output description
Removed 'accuracy' as it's used to evaluate node classification performance, not NLG quality. The paper does not use any automatic metrics to evaluate the generated text descriptions themselves.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted. LLMs are used only for generation, not for evaluating the generated outputs.
No human evaluation of the generated text descriptions is mentioned in the paper.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on using LLMs to generate node descriptions for graph-to-text conversion, but evaluates the downstream task performance (node classification accuracy) rather than the NLG quality itself. No automatic metrics or human evaluations specifically assess the generated text quality. The NLG aspect is a means to an end (feature alignment) rather than the primary evaluation focus.
